WM MEATS

LOCATED: GLADESTONE 2440 NSW

About WM Meats

WM Meats is a family-run butcher located in Gladestone, NSW, dedicated to providing high-quality, free-range meats to the community. They take pride in offering a large range of produce, from pasture-raised beef to local free-range pork. Their commitment to sourcing the best quality meats ensures that our customers receive only the finest products.

At WM Meats, They believe in supporting local farmers and promoting sustainable farming practices. They work closely with their suppliers to ensure that our meats are ethically sourced and of the highest standard. Their team of experienced butchers are passionate about their craft and take great care in preparing each cut of meat to perfection.

Whether you're looking for a juicy steak for the grill or a succulent roast for a special occasion, WM Meats has you covered. experience the difference that quality, free-range meats can make in your meals.

Delivery timeframe

THIS FARM DELIVERS WEEKLY

Please understand that our farmers and butchers are committed to ensuring your order arrives on time and within the specified timeframe. However, due to high demand or product shortages, there may be occasions when your order is rescheduled for the following week's delivery window

Grass Fed mid north coast Beef

Mid North Coast Beef is delicious and natural. Raised on the green pastures of Australia's Mid North Coast, it's packed with flavor and tenderness. No hormones or antibiotics are used, making it pure and wholesome. Whether you grill it, roast it, or cook it slowly, Mid North Coast Beef promises a tasty meal every time. With its high quality and great taste, it's perfect for any dish. Enjoy the goodness of the countryside with this beef, bringing a taste of Australia to your table with each bite.
